reason: Free moving of my data is nice, but 25 dollars a month is a real chunk when I make about 500 a month, and nobody I know uses this. I would try the free 14 days at most, I would not pay yet.
objection: No references. I have no one to ask if it really works, and if the move of my clients goes wrong or the team stops using it, I lose weeks and my client list is a mess.
would_change_my_mind: Another shop owner I know in Uzbekistan telling me they use it, plus someone doing the move in front of me and a lower price, around 10 to 15 dollars.
